title: Mockenhaupt's Three-Term Hardy-Littlewood Majorant Conjecture
summary: For an integer $k \ge 0$, let $f_k(x) = 1 + e(x) + e((k+2)x)$ and $g_k(x) = 1 + e(x) - e((k+2)x)$ on $\mathbb{T} = \mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$, where $e(x) = e^{2πi x}$. Mockenhaupt conjectured that $\|g_k\|_{L^p(\mathbb{T})} > \|f_k\|_{L^p(\mathbb{T})}$ whenever $2k < p < 2k+2$. The conjecture was previously known for $k \le 5$. We give a single analytic proof valid for every $k \ge 4$; in particular, this settles all previously open cases $k \ge 6$ and establishes the conjecture for every $k \ge 0$.
